# Curogram

> > Curogram is a HIPAA-compliant patient communication and practice management platform that transforms healthcare delivery through secure SMS texting, telemedicine, and workflow automation.

Curogram provides healthcare practices with an integrated suite of tools for patient engagement, appointment management, and secure communication. The platform emphasizes HIPAA compliance, EMR integration, and automation to reduce no-shows, improve patient retention, and streamline administrative workflows.

## Key Topics

- HIPAA-compliant texting
- Patient engagement
- Appointment reminders
- Secure messaging
- Telemedicine
- SMS communication
- EMR integration
- Practice management
- Patient acquisition
- Workflow automation
- Text-to-Pay
- Reputation management
- No-show reduction
- Online patient forms
- Healthcare VoIP

## Core Communication Products

- [HIPAA Compliant Texting App](https://curogram.com/hipaa-compliant-texting): Core product page for HIPAA-compliant secure patient texting solution
- [HIPAA-Compliant Secure Patient Text Messaging](https://curogram.com/hipaa-compliant-text-communication): Secure HIPAA-compliant text messaging protecting patient PHI
- [Mass Text Messaging for Patient Outreach & Care](https://curogram.com/mass-text-messaging): Bulk SMS service for patient outreach, reminders, and engagement
- [Online Chat Request: Convert Website Visitors Into Patients](https://curogram.com/online-chat-hipaa): Real-time SMS chat and appointment scheduling from website

## Patient Engagement & Retention

- [Patient Appointment Reminder System for Medical Practices](https://curogram.com/text-patient-reminders): Appointment reminder system reducing no-shows with HIPAA compliance
- [Patient Engagement, Reduced No-Shows](https://curogram.com/patient-engagement): Patient engagement tools for reminders, feedback, and retention
- [Automated Healthcare Reputation Management to Boost 5-star Reviews](https://curogram.com/reputation-management): Reputation management tool for automated review requests across platforms
- [Missed Call & Voicemail-to-Text: Never Lose a Patient Inquiry](https://curogram.com/missed-calls): Missed call recovery and voicemail-to-text with VoIP integration

## Practice Management & Automation

- [Secure HIPAA Compliant Online Forms to Streamline Patient Intake](https://curogram.com/online-patient-form): HIPAA-compliant online patient intake forms with EMR integration
- [Patient Workflow Automation: Improve Efficiency](https://curogram.com/patient-workflows): Workflow automation for intake, scheduling, task management
- [Online Chat and Appointment Booking](https://curogram.com/patient-acquisition): Patient acquisition via online chat, missed call recovery, booking
- [Healthcare Practice Analytics: Real-Time Insights](https://curogram.com/practice-analytics): Real-time analytics dashboards for productivity and practice metrics
- [Call Center Solutions: Advanced Patient Texting Tools](https://curogram.com/call-center-solutions): Call center patient texting tools improving efficiency and productivity

## Telemedicine & Virtual Care

- [Telehealth Software: Secure, Convenient Virtual Care Platform](https://curogram.com/telehealth-software): HIPAA-compliant telemedicine platform with EMR integration
- [HIPAA-Compliant Telemedicine & Virtual Visits](https://curogram.com/telemedicine): HIPAA-compliant telemedicine platform for secure virtual visits

## Payments & Financial Tools

- [Text to Pay: Secure & Convenient Text Message Payments for Healthcare](https://curogram.com/text-to-pay): HIPAA-compliant Text to Pay for secure SMS payment collection

## Integrations & Technical Reference

- [EMR Integration: Sync Patient Data & Automate Workflows](https://curogram.com/emr-integrations): EMR/EHR integration with API support for data synchronization
- [Healthcare VOIP Integration: Enhance Patient Communication](https://curogram.com/voip-integration): VoIP integration with RingCentral, Dialpad, Vonage, 8x8
